scope: Descriptive paired validation pocket errors at LR1e-4 for seeds42/43, one fixed PDB-grouped validation split; no causal inference or confidence intervals.
limitations: Corrected/newly-wrong means relative to the paired trained configuration; it is not proof of a causal molecular feature effect.
208 pockets correspond to110 PDB groups and are not208 independent proteins.
Two seeds reuse the same validation cases and are not independent datasets.
Balanced accuracy weights classes equally, so a net gain in total correct pockets can coexist with a lower balanced accuracy.
A differs from the legacy Only-GVP baseline; metal-node contrasts also change fitted edge normalization.
No held-out test or model promotion.
